item.title: Re: SCP IDEA: "Home"
item.content:encoded:
Resummoned via PM:

Hi again Agent Frog. Thanks for clarifying your central narrative. What you've given us is a good exploration log (the MTF raiding the place and never returning). The problem is how do we get to this point (how was the village discovered initially by the Foundation), and what happens after (the Foundation will not allow a missing MTF team to go unanswered).

More importantly, you haven't provided us with an explanation to the village's existence. Why does it create such anomalous effects? Is there a reason you've tied the main emotion to nostalgia?

item.title: Re: SCP IDEA: "Home"
item.content:encoded:
Summoned via PM:

Hi there Agent Frog. Let’s take a look at your concept.

So I like the initial idea. Sentient towns are quite common on the wiki though, so I think you will need to do more to distinguish your idea.

For starters, what you’ve listed under “Central Narrative” is not a narrative. Instead, you’ve basically outlined how the scp works (which should be summarised in your Elevator Pitch instead. What you need for a narrative can vary, but usually takes the form of a self-contained storyline that exists within the confines of the overarching scp. So for example, could one of your narratives we follow be from the perspective of someone who visits the town and then sees the anomalous effects at work? Is your narrative from the perspective of one of the townsfolk / leaders, who explain why this is happening and what the town’s ultimate goals are?

What we’re basically saying is a concept alone is not enough these days for an article to survive on the mainlist. You need to give us a story that goes along with it.

If you decide to revise the concept / respond below, do drop me another PM and I’ll do my best to take another look at it. For now, all the best!

Author,

Per the required reading forum guidelines, please fill out the concept template to seek feedback on your idea:

 **Seeking Greenlights:** Put yes or no. **Page Type:** SCP Article, Tale, GoI Format, Joke SCP, Site Dossier, Other (specify) **Genre (Optional):** Horror, Drama/Emotional, Comedy, Action, History, Other (specify) **Page Layout (Optional):** [How will you will structure the page in terms of information presentation, or plot development? If you plan on using a unique format/format screw, describe that here.] **Elevator Pitch:** [What is the basic core idea? Use a bullet point list if necessary.] **Central Narrative:** [Describe the story beats or overarching context/"big picture" for your piece. If there is no story content, put "none".] **Hook/Attention-Grabber:** [What is novel/unique about your premise? What is special about your idea here that will make it stand out among the other works already on the mainsite?] **Additional Notes:** [Note any concerns or particular areas of assistance you would like reviewers to focus on.]

Rather than posting a new comment, edit your previous post using the "edit" function under the "options" tab to the lower right of your first comment.

Remember that the combined text for your answers to the last four sections (Elevator Pitch, Central Narrative, Hook/Attention-Grabber, and Additional Notes) MAY NOT exceed 400 words. For convenience, authors can use this page to check wordcount: https://wordcounter.net/

Once you have revised your post accordingly, please reach out to reviewers to request that they look at your thread. You can find example lists of contacts in the Required Reading thread linked above.

item.title: SCP IDEA: "Home"
item.content:encoded:
Seeking Greenlights: Yes

Page Type: SCP Article

Elevator Pitch: The SCP is a anomalous village in Siberia that transforms the humanoid inhabitants of the village and the structures in the village to give the person staying in the town a sense of nostalgia and happiness. When the person who came across the village tries to leave they will either be forced to stay physically or mentally. The village may instill feelings of guilt for leaving or just be such a paradise for the person they don't want to leave. After 2-3 weeks of being in the village you will somehow transform into one of the humanoid creatures.

Central Narrative: The SCP article follows a MTF that raided the village and encountered humanoid creatures who look like native Siberian people. The villages inhabitants transform to become familiar people to the MTF. The structures also transform to resemble a nostalgic place in their childhood or other buildings that make them feel at home. The MTF is told to leave but are too mesmerized by the village to leave. The MTF agents aren't heard of again after this.

Hook/Attention-Grabber: The town seems mostly normal but it continues to get weirder in ways it can get in your head.

Additional Notes: I need most assistance on how you get turned into the entity and how else the entities should work.
